text:
elena: FYI we got an RFP follow-up from a regulated customer asking for signed audit events, per-tenant export, 7-year retention, and a 24h SLA for evidence requests. They also want proof of KMS/HSM attestations. Can we cover this today? :thinking:

kevin: We emit audit events today, but signing + key proofs are not in the schema. We'll need to add fields for signature metadata and key references. Also RBAC for export needs to be scoped to customer orgs.

maria: For FedRAMP/HIPAA customers, chain-of-custody and BAA clauses matter. 7-year retention is plausible but legal needs to confirm data residency + export controls. Don't promise SLA changes without legal sign-off.

tom: Technically we can do detached signatures using our KMS provider. Proposal: store the canonical event JSON in audit-store and add a small metadata envelope: `signature`, `alg`, `key_id`, `key_fingerprint`, `signed_at`, `signature_scheme`. Sample:```json
{
  "event_id": "evt-2026-06-15-0001",
  "actor": "svc-token-123",
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": "model:prod/llama-3-7b",
  "ts": "2026-06-15T16:12:03Z",
  "signature": "MEYCIQDx...",
  "key_id": "projects/redwood-kms/keys/audit-signing-key",
  "signature_scheme": "RSASSA-PSS-SHA256"
}```

kevin: That looks good. We should be careful about storing signatures in the same table as event bodies to avoid accidental truncation by downstream consumers. Also need to decide if key is our HSM or customer-managed. Customer-managed keys (CMK) have different legal/ops implications.

elena: For the export flow they want an on-demand per-tenant bundle and a push to their SIEM. That triggers RBAC and rate-limiting concerns — if we allow full-history exports, we need a quarantine workflow for PII hits and a signed ACK from the requesting org.

sec-bot: Automation note: existing doc `runbook/audit-evidence-request` contains a checklist for evidence packages (hashes, signatures, manifest). Link: https://internal.runbook/audit-evidence-request :lock:

maria: Also flag: FedRAMP marketplaces sometimes ask for signed evidence plus hardware attestation (e.g., HSM cert chain). Can legal/ops produce attestation artifacts? That usually needs procurement + additional SLAs.

tom: Implementation rough plan: 1) schema PR to add signature envelope + key_id field (minor, backward compatible). 2) KMS client wrapper to create detached signatures and return fingerprint. 3) new export endpoint: `GET /tenants/{id}/audit/export?since=...` that packages signed events + manifest + signature chain. 4) RBAC check + export approval workflow (UI + API) to prevent accidental mass exports.

kevin: Contract implications: evidence delivery SLA (24h) is operationally heavy — suggest mapping to pricing tiers or reserved capacity for exports. Also must add language about key ownership and responsibility for custody of CMKs. I'll draft contract language.

elena: Action items: @mary will own KMS POC (POC due EOW). @tom will open schema PR and add sample event test. @kevin will draft a short contract clause and acceptance criteria. @maria will run legal/compliance check on retention + attestation asks. I'll coordinate with the customer on exact file format they need.

mary: Happy to pick up the POC. I'll validate HSM attestation artifact formats (X.509 chain, AKV/AWS KMS certs) and test signing latency.

tom: I'll create branch `audit/signature-envelope` and include migration notes.

kevin: I'll add a short appendix to the SLA doc with export pricing and an option to add a 24h evidence premium.

elena: Thanks. Let's sync in tomorrow's sec-standup for blockers. :white_check_mark:
